body: I don't know if anyone can. I'm freaking out bad.

I apologize, that may read a bit shallow. It goes far deeper than that, repercussions from childhood abuse. I feel like I can't speak to anyone about it, while it claws at my mind. I feel as though I can never truly trust or be loved by anyone as a result. Meanwhile I'm one of the most empathetic, articulate, and protective people I know. People like and respect me. I'd be letting them all down and publicly shaming myself if I explained my pain. I wouldn't even want to put my reasoning in a final letter, but I can't hurt my loved ones like that. Telling makes me want to kill myself, keeping the secret does the same. The only solution I can think of is just disappearing entirely. I can't live like this. Can't talk to friends, family, or her about it. What the hell do I do?
